preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call setFees_base1000
swapEnabled must be true to trigger swapBack function
Contract must hold sufficient tokens to exceed swapThreshold

exploit_hint: 1. As owner, call setFees_base1000 with all fee parameters set to 0 (liquidityFee=0, marketingFee=0, teamFee=0, developmentFee=0, burnFee=0, buybackFee=0). 2. This sets totalFee to 0. 3. When swapBack() is triggered (via token transfer when contract balance >= swapThreshold), totalETHFee = totalFee - burnFee = 0. 4. Multiple division operations in swapBack() will divide by totalETHFee (0), causing transaction revert. 5. This effectively DoS the contract's swap functionality and breaks normal token operations.
